Attributes:

The name and the look are fixed. The joke ending is one of the ranger armor suffixes. That ending is what sets Agility / Endurance.

The rest of the stats roll and do not show up in the name.

  • Health / mana: health, mana, or both. Random.
  • Resists: a random pair or triple from divine, fire, ice, poison, and shadow.
  • Steal: health steal, mana steal, or both. Random.
  • Stun: enemy stun chance, stun resistance, or both. Random.

It is unknown how many different varieties exist. The same ending can still drop with different rolls underneath.

It is unknown how many different varieties of this particular mythic item exist. Some of the Mythic items in this series may have the same name but different attributes. It is unknown if this is intentional or a bug.

Listed below, are the varieties known to exist.
